name: OpenWrt DNS v0 Resolver Inspection Adapter
description: Supported adapter mapping for Linux/OpenWrt read-only DNS resolver inspection via /etc/resolv.conf for the DNS explicit resolver invariant. The OpenWrt adapter directory presence alone is UNIMPLEMENTED outside the validated DNS v0 capability.

declared_capabilities.name: OpenWrt/Linux DNS resolver inspection v0
declared_capabilities.description: Read-only observation of explicit resolver configuration in /etc/resolv.conf for the DNS explicit resolver invariant on Linux/OpenWrt targets.

notes: Only the DNS v0 capability above is supported; adapter directory alone is not support status.
